I enjoy listening, learning, adapting and networking in diverse markets and culture, and leveraging my multifaceted knowledge to drive effective strategy tailored for local situations. I work with a collaborative, considered approach with teams to provide pragmatic solutions applying business mindset and integrated thinking to remove silos, achieve business goals and enhance customer / employee experience. I am committed to support people to be at their best by creating an inclusive, healthy and engaged working environment.
